queries.compiledQueryString: select month, outcome, count(*) as orders from (select * from pps.service_monthly) group by 1, 2 order by 1
queries.inputQueryString: select month, outcome, count(*) as orders from ${orders} group by 1, 2 order by 1

queries.compiledQueryString: select month, avg(case when on_time then 1.0 else 0 end) as on_time_pct from (select * from pps.service_monthly) group by 1 order by 1
queries.inputQueryString: select month, avg(case when on_time then 1.0 else 0 end) as on_time_pct from ${orders} group by 1 order by 1

queries.compiledQueryString:
select customer, count(*) as orders,
       avg(case when on_time then 1.0 else 0 end) as on_time_pct,
       sum(case when outcome = 'Late: rush order' then 1 else 0 end) as late_rush,
       sum(case when outcome = 'Late: shipment held' then 1 else 0 end) as late_held,
       avg(case when rush then 1.0 else 0 end) as rush_share
from (select * from pps.service_monthly) group by 1 order by on_time_pct
queries.inputQueryString:
select customer, count(*) as orders,
       avg(case when on_time then 1.0 else 0 end) as on_time_pct,
       sum(case when outcome = 'Late: rush order' then 1 else 0 end) as late_rush,
       sum(case when outcome = 'Late: shipment held' then 1 else 0 end) as late_held,
       avg(case when rush then 1.0 else 0 end) as rush_share
from ${orders} group by 1 order by on_time_pct

queries.compiledQueryString:
select avg(case when on_time then 1.0 else 0 end) as on_time_pct,
       sum(case when not on_time then 1 else 0 end) as late_orders,
       avg(case when rush then 1.0 else 0 end) as rush_share
from (select * from pps.service_monthly)
